note: Words that point at something instead of naming it. Repeating a proper noun is always allowed and usually better: a reader who arrives mid-page still knows what is being discussed. Repetition is not a fault here.

banned.that: name the thing (allowed as a conjunction: 'the log that survives')
banned.some: give the number or the name
banned.one: name the thing (allowed in counting: 'one listing')
